name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2010 in Intrusions (ICS)
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. The ten ATT&CK for ICS techniques that ATT&CK lists for Stuxnet (S0603) and that the 2010 record most directly supports: ICS-CERT's advisories on the USB-borne trojan that interacts with Siemens SIMATIC WinCC and STEP 7, its spread through MS08-067, the print spooler flaw and STEP 7 project files, and Symantec's dossier dating the reported PLC code injection to 6 August 2010. No 2010 source prints an ATT&CK id. The Stuxnet case study carries all 25 ICS techniques. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2010.md. Scores: 100 the ATT&CK object prints the id.
